examples.text: āmasanā, parāmasanā, omasanā, ummasanā, olaṅghanā, ullaṅghanā, ākaḍḍhanā, patikaḍḍhanā, abhiniggaṇhanā, abhinippīḷanā, gahaṇaṃ, chupanaṃ.

12103.meaning2: fellow religious student belonging to the same house or community

examples.text: katamāni cattāri? āmaṃ pakkavaṇṇi, pakkaṃ āmavaṇṇi, āmaṃ āmavaṇṇi, pakkaṃ pakkavaṇṇi, imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri ambāni. evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, cattāro amb'ūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
pañc'ime, bhikkhave, ānisaṃsā yāguyā. katame pañca? khuddaṃ paṭihanati, pipāsaṃ paṭivineti, vātaṃ anulometi, vatthiṃ sodheti, ām'āvasesaṃ pāceti. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ānisaṃsā yāguyā'ti.
addasā kho āyasmā mahākassapo taṃ ājīvakaṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ, disvā taṃ ājīvakaṃ etadavoca, ap'āvuso, amhākaṃ satthāraṃ jānāsī'ti? ām'āvuso, jānāmi, ajja satt'āhaparinibbuto samaṇo gotamo.

12115.synonym: oḷārika, kabaliṅkāra, kabaḷiṅkāra, kabaḷiṃkāra, kabaḷīkāra, kavaḷīkāra, rūpavant, rūpī, sāmisa

examples.text: bhagavā etadavoca, dhammadāy'ādā me, bhikkhave, bhavatha, mā āmisadāy'ādā
tattha katamāni cha gehasitāni somanassāni? cakkhuviññeyyānaṃ rūpānaṃ iṭṭhānaṃ kantānaṃ manāpānaṃ manoramānaṃ loka-āmisa-paṭisaṃyuttānaṃ paṭilābhaṃ vā paṭilābhato samanupassato

12116.commentary: (VIN) āmisahetū'ti cīvarahetu piṇḍapātahetu sen'āsanahetu gilānappaccaya-bhesajja-parikkhāra-hetu sakkārahetu garukārahetu mānanahetu vandanahetu pūjanahetu.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya, āmisahetu therā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo ovadantī'ti, pācittiyaṃ.

12117.meaning1: worldly thing; physical item; material stuff

examples.text: āmisasambhogo nāma āmisaṃ deti vā paṭiggaṇhāti vā, āpatti pācittiyassa.
dve'me, bhikkhave, saṃvibhāgā āmisasaṃvibhāgo ca dhammasaṃvibhāgo ca. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ dvinnaṃ saṃvibhāgānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammasaṃvibhāgo.

12118.commentary: (SNa) āmisaṃ'va macchānaṃ vadhāya khittā'ti yathā macchānaṃ vadhatthāya baḷisalaggaṃ āmisaṃ khipati, evaṃ tayā pasaṃsamānena ete rūpā sattānaṃ vadhāya khittā'ti vadati.

examples.text: ye keci rūpā idha vā huraṃ vā, ye c'antalikkhasmiṃ pabhāsavaṇṇā, sabb'eva te te namucippasatthā, āmisaṃ'va macchānaṃ vadhāya khittā'ti.
vipariṇāmadhammato asārakato aghamūlato vadhakato vibhavato sāsavato saṅkhatato māra-āmisato

12121.meaning1: for the sake of some small worldly benefit
12121.commentary: (ANa) āmisakiñcikkhahetu vā'ti ettha āmisan'ti lañjo adhippeto. kiñcikkhan'ti yaṃ vā taṃ vā appamattakaṃ antamaso tittiriya-vaṭṭaka-sappi-piṇḍa-navanīta-piṇḍ'ādi-mattakassa lañjassa hetū'ti attho.

examples.text: iti attahetu vā parahetu vā āmisakiñcikkhahetu vā sampajānamusā bhāsitā hoti. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, puggalo gūthabhāṇī.

12122.meaning2: lye, alkaline fluid (allowed as a treatment for constipation)

12123.meaning2: covered with meat, smeared with flesh; lit. gone through flesh

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, bāḷisiko āmisagataṃ baḷisaṃ gambhīre udakarahade pakkhipeyya. tam'enaṃ aññataro āmisacakkhu maccho gileyya.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, bāḷisiko āmisagatabaḷisaṃ gambhīre udakarahade pakkhipeyya. tam'enaṃ aññataro āmisacakkhu maccho gileyya.

12125.meaning1: valuing worldly gain; giving weight to material benefit

examples.text: yo'pi so, bhikkhave, satthā āmisagaru āmisadāy'ādo āmisehi saṃsaṭṭho viharati tassa pāyaṃ evarūpī paṇ'opaṇaviyā na upeti, evañ'ca no assa atha naṃ kareyyāma, na ca no evam'assa na naṃ kareyyāmā'ti, kiṃ pana, bhikkhave, yaṃ tathāgato sabbaso āmisehi visaṃsaṭṭho viharati.

12126.meaning1: with eyes only for the bait; with bait in sight

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, bāḷisiko āmisagatabaḷisaṃ gambhīre udakarahade pakkhipeyya. tam'enaṃ aññataro āmisacakkhu maccho gileyya.
katame dve? āmisacāgo ca dhammacāgo ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve cāgā.
āmis'aññataraṃ kho pan'etaṃ, yadidaṃ piṇḍapāto. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ imaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ abhuñjitvā iminā'va jighacchādubbalyena evaṃ imaṃ rattin'divaṃ vītināmeyyan'ti.

12129.meaning1: material gift; worldly charity; (comm) four requisites
12129.meaning2: donation of requisites (i.e. food, lodging, etc.)

examples.text: dve'māni, bhikkhave, dānāni āmisadānañ'ca dhammadānañ'ca. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ dvinnaṃ dānānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammadānaṃ.
yo vītarāgo vītarāgesu dadāti dānaṃ, dhammena laddhaṃ supasannacitto, abhisaddahaṃ kammaphalaṃ uḷāraṃ, taṃ ve dānaṃ āmisadānānam'aggan'ti.

12131.meaning1: material heir; inheritor of worldly things

examples.text: tassa me tumhe puttā orasā mukhato jātā dhammajā dhammanimmitā dhammadāy'ādā, no āmisadāy'ādā.
bhagavā etadavoca, dhammadāy'ādā me, bhikkhave, bhavatha, mā āmisadāy'ādā

12132.meaning1: for worldly gain; intent on material gain
12132.commentary: (ANa) na āmis'antaro'ti na āmisahetuko, attano catupaccayalābhaṃ anāsīsanto'ti attho.

examples.text: na āmis'antaro kathaṃ kathessāmī'ti paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo.

12133.commentary: (ADha) paṭisanthāraniddese āmisapaṭisanthāro'ti āmisa-alābhena attanā saha paresaṃ chiddaṃ yathā pihitaṃ hoti paṭicchannaṃ evaṃ āmisena paṭisantharaṇaṃ.

examples.text: katame dve? āmisapaṭisanthāro ca dhammapaṭisanthāro ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve paṭisanthārā.
āmisapariccāgo ca dhammapariccāgo ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve pariccāgā.
ajjhenan'ti mantagahaṇaṃ. cāgan'ti āmisapariccāgaṃ.
katamā dve? āmisapariyeṭṭhi ca dhammapariyeṭṭhi ca. imā kho, bhikkhave, dve pariyeṭṭhiyo.

12137.meaning1: mundane quest; searching for material things

examples.text: katamā dve? āmisapariyesanā ca dhammapariyesanā ca. imā kho, bhikkhave, dve pariyesanā.
katamā dve? āmisapūjā ca dhammapūjā ca. imā kho bhikkhave, dve pūjā.

12139.meaning1: use of material riches; enjoyment of worldly wealth

examples.text: katame dve? āmisabhogo ca dhammabhogo ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve bhogā.
dve'me, bhikkhave, yāgā āmisayāgo ca dhammayāgo ca. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ dvinnaṃ yāgānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammayāgo'ti.
katamāni dve? āmisaratanañ'ca dhammaratanañ'ca. imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve ratanāni.
āmisasaṅgaho ca dhammasaṅgaho ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve saṅgahā.

tato therā ime amhesu garucittīkāraṃ na karontī'ti navake bhikkhū dvīhi saṅgahehi na saṅgaṇhanti, n'eva dhammasaṅgahena saṅgaṇhanti, na āmisasaṅgahena, cīvarena vā pattena vā pattapariyāpannena vā vasanaṭṭhānena vā kilamante'pi nappaṭijagganti, pāḷiṃ vā aṭṭhakathaṃ vā dhammakathābandhaṃ vā guḷhaganthaṃ vā na sikkhāpenti.

12143.meaning2: laying out, distribution, of material goods
12143.commentary: (ANa) catūhi paccayehi attano ca parassa ca antarapaṭicchādanavasena santharaṇaṃ āmisasanthāro, dhammena santharaṇaṃ dhammasanthāro.

examples.text: katame dve? āmisasanthāro ca dhammasanthāro ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve santhārā.

12144.commentary: (ANa) āmisassa cinanaṃ vaḍḍhanaṃ āmisasannicayo, dhammassa cinanaṃ vaḍḍhanaṃ dhammasannicayo.

examples.text: katame dve? āmisasannicayo ca dhammasannicayo ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve sannicayā.

12145.meaning1: store of material items; accumulation of physical goods
12145.meaning2: store of material items; store of ingredients

examples.text: seyyath'idaṃ, annasannidhiṃ pānasannidhiṃ vatthasannidhiṃ yānasannidhiṃ sayanasannidhiṃ gandhasannidhiṃ āmisasannidhiṃ iti vā iti evarūpā sannidhikāraparibhogā paṭivirato samaṇo gotamo'ti, iti vā hi, bhikkhave, puthujjano tathāgatassa vaṇṇaṃ vadamāno vadeyya.

12146.meaning1: partaking of worldly things together; mutual enjoyment of material items
12146.commentary: (VIN 2.5.7.9) āmisasambhogo nāma āmisaṃ deti vā paṭiggaṇhāti vā, āpatti pācittiyassa.

examples.text: sambhuñjeyya vā'ti sambhogo nāma dve sambhogā, āmisasambhogo ca dhammasambhogo ca.

12147.meaning1: sharing material things; distribution of worldly items

examples.text: dve'me, bhikkhave, saṃvibhāgā āmisasaṃvibhāgo ca dhammasaṃvibhāgo ca. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ dvinnaṃ saṃvibhāgānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammasaṃvibhāgo.
katamā dve? āmisavuddhi ca dhammavuddhi ca. imā kho, bhikkhave, dve vuddhiyo.
katamāni dve? āmisavepullañ'ca dhammavepullañ'ca. imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve vepullāni.

12151.meaning1: for the sake of material benefit; for profit
12151.commentary: (VIN 2.5.3.4) āmisahetū'ti cīvarahetu piṇḍapātahetu sen'āsanahetu gilānappaccaya-bhesajja-parikkhāra-hetu sakkārahetu garukārahetu mānanahetu vandanahetu pūjanahetu.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya, āmisahetu therā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo ovadantī'ti, pācittiyaṃ.

12152.meaning1: who for the sake of material benefit; who for profit

examples.text: katamāni dve? āmis'ātitheyyañ'ca dhamm'ātitheyyañ'ca. imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve ātitheyyāni.
katamā dve? āmis'ānukampā ca dhamm'ānukampā ca. imā kho, bhikkhave, dve anukampā.
dve'me, bhikkhave, anuggahā āmis'ānuggaho ca dhamm'ānuggaho ca. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ dvinnaṃ anuggahānaṃ yadidaṃ dhamm'ānuggaho.

12156.meaning1: providing for one's material needs; giving physical sustenance
12156.commentary: (DNa) āmis'ānuppadānenā'ti purebhattaṃ paribhuñjitabbakaṃ āmisaṃ nāma, tasmā sīlavantānaṃ yāgubhatta-sampadānenā'ti attho.

examples.text: pañcahi kho, gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi kulaputtena uparimā disā samaṇabrāhmaṇā paccupaṭṭhātabbā, mettena kāyakammena mettena vacīkammena mettena manokammena anāvaṭadvāratāya āmis'ānuppadānena.
katamā dve? āmis'iddhi ca dhamm'iddhi ca. imā kho, bhikkhave, dve iddhiyo.
katamā dve? āmis'esanā ca dhamm'esanā ca. imā kho, bhikkhave, dve esanā.

12160.meaning1: adorned with gems and jewellery; dressed in jewels and rings

examples.text: sataṃ hatthī sataṃ assā, sataṃ assatarīrathā, sataṃ kaññāsahassāni, āmukkamaṇikuṇḍalā, ekassa padavītihārassa, kalaṃ n'āgghanti soḷasiṃ.

12161.meaning1: adorned with gems, rings and jewellery

examples.text: evaṃ su te sunhātā suvilittā kappitakesamassū āmukkamaṇikuṇḍalābharaṇā odātavatthavasanā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgībhūtā paricārenti, seyyathā'pi tvaṃ eta'r'ahi sācariyako'ti?

api nu tassa purisassa sunhātassa suvilittassa sukappitakesamassussa āmukkamāl'ābharaṇassa odātavatthavasanassa uparipāsādavaragatassa pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitassa samaṅgībhūtassa paricārayamānassa puna'd'eva tasmiṃ gūthakūpe nimujjitu'kāmatā assā'ti?
so buddho cakkavattissa, jeṭṭho dayita-oraso, āmukkamālābharaṇo, uyyānaṃ upasaṅkami.
vicittavatth'ābharaṇā, āmuttamaṇikuṇḍalā, kusalā naccagītassa, sakkassa paricārikā.
tisahassāni sūdāni hi, āmuttamaṇikuṇḍalā, aṅkuraṃ upajīvanti, dāne yaññassa vāvaṭā.

12166.meaning1: adorned with jewels and jewellery; decorated with gems and rings
12166.meaning2: with jewelled earrings put on, wearing jewelled earrings

examples.text: tisahassāni sūdāni hi, āmuttamaṇikuṇḍalā, aṅkuraṃ upajīvanti, dāne yaññassa vāvaṭā.

evaṃ su te sunhātā suvilittā kappitakesamassū āmuttamāl'ābharaṇā odātavatthavasanā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgībhūtā paricārenti, seyyathā'pi tvaṃ eta'r'ahi sācariyako'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho gotama.
evam'eva iminā kāraṇena āyatiṃ avassaṃ bhijjissati, so ca kho kalahavasena na saṅghabhedavasena, tasmā bhinno'ti vuttaṃ. sambhama-atthavasena c'ettha āmeḍitaṃ veditabbaṃ.

12170.synonym: api, āma, eva, kāmaṃ, khu, kho, byā, vata, hi

examples.text: ty'āhaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadāmi, saccaṃ kira tumhe āyasmanto issarakuttaṃ brahmakuttaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapethā'ti? te ca me evaṃ puṭṭhā, āmo'ti paṭijānanti.

12175.meaning1: rejoicing; being glad; being pleased; delighting
12175.commentary: (SNa) āmodamāno'ti tuṭṭhamānaso hutvā. (ITIa) āmodamāno pakiretī'ti tuṭṭhahaṭṭhamānaso sahatthena dānaṃ dento paṭiggāhakakhette deyyadhammaṃ pakirento viya hoti, vācāya'pi detha dethā'ti bhāsati.

examples.text: āmodamāno pakireti, detha dethā'ti bhāsati, taṃ hi'ssa gajjitaṃ hoti, devass'eva pavassato, sā puññadhārā vipulā, dātāraṃ abhivassatī'ti.
subhikkhavāco puriso, sabbabhūt'ānukampako, āmodamāno pakireti, detha dethā'ti bhāsati.
pabhā niddhāvate tassa, sataraṃsī'va uggato, ākiṇṇo devakaññāhi, āmodiṃ kāmakām'ahaṃ.

12178.synonym: attamana, abhiraddha, patīta, pamudita, pamodita, pahaṭṭha, pahaṃsita, pīṇita, matta, rata, vitta, sampahaṃsita, sammudita, sukhita

examples.text: ādhāvitvā vidhāvitvā kīḷanakāle pana lobhanīyavayasmiṃ vā ṭhitakāle dārakaṃ oloketvā mātāpitūnaṃ cittaṃ sappimaṇḍe pakkhittasatavihatakappāsapicupaṭalaṃ viya mudukaṃ hoti āmoditaṃ pamoditaṃ, tadā tesaṃ muditā labbhati.
[chaṭṭhaṃ ukkānattham'evā'ti aṭṭhakathāyaṃ dassitaṃ, pāḷipotthakesu pana katthaci'pi na dissati. … āmaṃ pakk'obhāsaṃ, pakkaṃ ām'obhāsan'ti-ādinā pāṭho bhaveyya]
tassa n'ev'assa puratthimāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ
tena hi, bhaṇe, yo bāhiresu janapadesu āyo sañjāyati tato upaḍḍhaṃ antepure pavesetha, upaḍḍhaṃ tatth'eva dānaṃ detha samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-kapaṇ'addhika-vanibbaka-yācakānan'ti.

12184.meaning1: (gram) āya suffix; used to form denominative verbs

examples.text: 435, 536. āya nāmato katt'ūpamānā'd'ācāre.

nāmato katt'ūpamānā ācār'atthe āyapaccayo hoti. saṅgho pabbatam'iva attānam'ācarati, pabbatāyati, taḷākaṃ samuddam'iva attānam'ācarati, samuddāyati, saddo cicciṭam'iva attānam'ācarati, cicciṭāyati. evam'aññe'pi yojetabbā.
idaṃ kho, āvuso, cīvaraṃ maṃ uddissa viyyati, āyatañ'ca karotha, vitthatañ'ca, appitañ'ca, suvītañ'ca, suppavāyitañ'ca, suvilekhitañ'ca, suvitacchitañ'ca karotha
āyatapaṇhi kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā āyatakena gītassarena dhammaṃ bhaṇantassā'ti.

12193.construction:
ā + √yam + ta + ka + ena
āyataka + ena
12193.commentary: (ANa) na āyataken'eva papāto'ti na chinnataṭamahāsobbho viya ādito'va papāto. so hi tīrato paṭṭhāya ek'aṅgula-dv'aṅgula-vidatthi-ratana-yaṭṭhi-usabha-aḍḍhagāvuta-gāvuta-aḍḍhayojan'ādivasena gambhīro hutvā gacchanto sinerupādamūle caturāsīti-yojanasahassa-gambhīro hutvā ṭhito'ti dasseti. (ANa) na āyataken'eva aññāpaṭivedho'ti maṇḍūkassa uppatitvā gamanaṃ viya ādito'va sīlapūraṇ'ādiṃ akatvā arahattappaṭivedho nāma n'atthi, paṭipāṭiyā pana sīlasamādhipaññāyo pūretvā'va sakkā arahattaṃ pattun'ti attho.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, pahārāda, mahāsamuddo anupubbaninno anupubbapoṇo anupubbapabbhāro, na āyataken'eva papāto, evam'evaṃ kho, pahārāda, imasmiṃ dhammavinaye anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā, na āyataken'eva aññāpaṭivedho.

12194.meaning1: vast and great; extensive and best

examples.text: puññam'eva so sikkheyya, āyat'aggaṃ sukh'udrayaṃ, dānañ'ca samacariyañ'ca, mettacittañ'ca bhāvaye.
puññam'eva so sikkheyya, āyat'aggaṃ sukh'udrayaṃ, dānañ'ca samacariyañ'ca, mettacittañ'ca bhāvaye.

12196.meaning1: with the highest income; having the greatest profit
12196.commentary: (ITIa) āyat'aggan'ti… āyena vā yonisomanasikār'ādi-ppaccayena uḷāratamena aggan'ti āya't'aggaṃ. takāro padasandhikaro.

examples.text: puññam'eva so sikkheyya, āya't'aggaṃ sukh'udrayaṃ, dānañ'ca samacariyañ'ca, mettacittañ'ca bhāvaye.
evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca, cha kho, āvuso, ajjhattikāni āyatanāni eko anto, cha bāhirāni āyatanāni dutiyo anto, viññāṇaṃ majjhe, taṇhā sibbinī.
orimaṃ tīran'ti kho, bhikkhu, chann'etaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ. pārimaṃ tīran'ti kho, bhikkhu, chann'etaṃ bāhirānaṃ āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

orimaṃ tīran'ti kho, bhikkhu, chann'etaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ. pārimaṃ tīran'ti kho, bhikkhu, chann'etaṃ bāhirānaṃ āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
